author: KEXP
description: Western Australia's The Bures Band unleash a capsule of cosmic folk rock in our latest in-studio session. Live on KEXP, the Perth-based band share a performance of "Birds Nest" and more.
title: The Bures Band performs "Birds Nest" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
